beats.what: In the auto shop the dark-haired teenager watches three boys pin a classmate and mark him, and quietly pulls jumper-cable clamps out of a tool drawer
The blond jock in the #13 jersey crosses the student lot with his teammates and squares up to the dark-haired teenager for talking to his girlfriend
chars: the blond jock in the #13 jersey

beats.what: The jock refuses to put his $80,000 Viper up for pink slips against the teenager's beat-up muscle car
chars: the blond jock in the #13 jersey

beats.what: The blonde girl names herself as the prize, and the race is on
chars: the blond jock in the #13 jersey

beats.what: The two cars launch from a start line at the Shang-Ri-La Estates billboard into the half-built housing tract, the girl riding with the jock
chars: the blond jock in the #13 jersey

beats.what: Losing ground on the pavement, the teenager abandons the road and cuts straight across the raw dirt lots to make up the gap
The teenager runs his car up on two wheels and leans it against the Viper, taunting the jock as the girl starts to enjoy it
chars: the blond jock in the #13 jersey

beats.what: The cars collide and tumble end over end in front of the spectators, leaving the teenager hanging bloodied upside down in his belt
chars: the blond jock in the #13 jersey

beats.what: At the station a detective plays him the bystander video of the race and tells him the rich kids will walk while he is a guaranteed conviction
Told his car has been crushed, the teenager comes out of his chair at the detective and is shoved back down
His mother storms in swinging at him, then sits down and works the detective into a deal over his head
The detective lays out the arithmetic: two priors for reckless driving make this strike three and prison unless there is another way
In the corridor his mother tells him they are not moving this time, and he takes the sentence in silence
The teenager lands alone in Tokyo and rides a taxi out through the neon city
